div.head: Wi 5.1[b]
div.ab: ⁊ gehwæder þæt hæmed mid hreowe forlæte.

⁊ gehwæder þæt hæmed mid hreowe forlæte.
Und jeder von beiden verlasse jenes Verhältniss unter Bereuung.
And let each of the two give up that relationship with repentance.
and [in] either [case the offender] shall desist from the union, with repentance.
And let each of them relinquish the union with repentance.

note.seg: Das d in gehwæder ist vielleicht nicht, wie Frühere meinten, Schreibfehler für ð; vgl. Hl 8²
The d in gehwæder is perhaps not, as earlier scholars thought, a scribal error for ð; cf. Hl 8²
